_note: German (du, lower case; German capitalisation; „…“ for quotation marks), not yet reviewed by a German speaker. The glossary is in docs/translating.md. The right column's tool tabs (Timer, Nachrichten, Grafiken, Makros, Bühne, Audio, VoxLive) and what they draw: cards, menus, fields, empty states, timer kinds, macro steps, stage layout items and the stage screens' NEXT label (ALS NÄCHSTES), and what saving these things says; the captions the code writes in capitals (LÄUFT, ÜBERBLENDEN, the VoxLive note) are capitals here too, and .short rows are used where the usual words don't fit their room.
